title: Sant Esteve Cannelloni
description: The quintessential second course of Catalan Christmas, traditionally eaten on 26 December. Baked cannelloni stuffed with the leftover roasted meats from Christmas, topped with béchamel and cheese.

instructions.title: Prepare the filling
instructions.description: Mince or finely chop the leftover roast meat.

instructions.title: Sauté
instructions.description: Sauté the chopped onion in oil until soft, add the crushed tomato and let it reduce; stir in the meat and season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.

instructions.title: Cook the cannelloni
instructions.description: Cook the cannelloni tubes according to the package instructions and let them cool on a clean cloth.

instructions.title: Stuff
instructions.description: Stuff the cannelloni with the meat mixture and roll them up; place them tightly in a baking dish.

instructions.title: Bake
instructions.description: Cover with béchamel and grated cheese and bake at 200 °C until golden and bubbling.
